objective_value: <float> Total cost of the routing plan, combining service costs on required edges and travel costs on deadheaded edges across all vehicles.

routes.vehicle: <int> Identifier of the vehicle performing this route.
routes.serviced_edges: <list[int]> Identifiers of the required edges that this vehicle services during its route.

deadheaded_edges.edge_id: <int> Identifier of an edge traversed by this vehicle without servicing it.
deadheaded_edges.times: <int> Number of times this vehicle traverses the edge as deadheading.
